headline: Disk is critical at 92.7% and recurring gateway timeouts are failing requests; free disk space today.
summary: Disk 92.7% exceeds the 90% critical threshold. Memory 83.1% exceeds the 75% warning threshold and is flat across the history window. Logs show 14 gateway ReadTimeout errors in 24h.
metrics_note: CPU 34.2% normal; memory 83.1% warning; disk 92.7% critical.
logs_note: 14 ERROR entries from app.log: gateway ReadTimeout, 12:06-12:58 on 2026-10-27; 3 WARNING validator rejections; no critical-level log events.
trend_note: Recurring vs history window: disk 92.7%, memory 83.1%, and app.log repeated error first seen 2026-10-28T01:38. Disk dipped to 80.9% in an interim report then returned to 92.7%; memory held at 83.0-83.1%. No metric moved more than 15 points since the previous report (CPU 34.2%, memory 83.1%, disk 92.7%). No applied fix exists in history, so no post-fix recurrence escalation.

findings.title: Disk usage at 92.7%
findings.evidence: disk_percent 92.7%, above 90% critical threshold; Chip status critical: 'High Disk: 92.7%'. History shows same title on 2026-10-28T01:38 and disk at 80.9% in an interim report before returning to 92.7%.
findings.impact: Disk will fill to 100% at the current level; writes, logs, and services will fail when it does.
findings.trend: Recurring, first seen 2026-10-28T01:38; worsening from interim 80.9% back to 92.7%.

findings.title: app.log: repeated gateway ReadTimeout error (14x)
findings.evidence: 14 ERROR entries in 24h from app.log, pattern 'gateway ReadTimeout: model gateway did not respond within 30s (attempt N/N)', example '2026-10-27T12:58:00 ERROR gateway ReadTimeout: model gateway did not respond within 30s (attempt 3/3) req_id=a000f2'. Exceeds 5-errors-from-one-source rule.
findings.impact: Requests depending on the model gateway are timing out after 3 attempts and failing.
findings.trend: Recurring, first seen in history as 'app.log: repeated error (14x)' on 2026-10-28T01:38; same count and pattern today.

findings.title: Memory usage at 83.1%
findings.evidence: memory_percent 83.1%, above 75% warning threshold; history shows 83.1% on 2026-10-28T01:38 and 83.0% on 2026-10-28T01:41.
findings.impact: Memory headroom is 16.9%; a further rise risks swapping or OOM kills with no identified top process in today's data.
findings.trend: Recurring, first seen 2026-10-28T01:38; flat at 83.0-83.1% across reports, persistent rather than a single spike.
